notes.title: Inescaped Paranoia Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921203/549f847ac2dc4ca4bf844865d30f102b92bb729a.png[/img]

Hey everybody, I am Arange back with major update for Inescaped. This time it is a singleplayer update that adds a lot of things which I will talk about below here.

So, firstly Inescaped Paranoia adds a brand new psychological horror experience that is filled with creepy dolls, scary jumpscares and chilling ambiance. This update focuses on the horror aspect of the game, adding multiple jumpscares and creating a creepy and chilling atmosphere.

The game also features puzzles, some are unique that makes you use the equipments you find in the environment and Some puzzles are classic like the jigsaw image puzzle. The puzzles are fun and engaging and will need a little bit of brain power to solve them.

The story is of Subject #34 who is a building inspector sent to assess an abandoned farmhouse, the routine job quickly turns into a descent into fear and uncertainty. The story is conveyed through letters and NPC conversations. 

The average gameplay is almost around an hour. The game's price has also dropped to $3.99 and will stay at $3.99 until the multiplayer comes out of maintenance in the first week of April. Do check out the game and let me know what you think. Leave a review no matter negative or positive. All feedbacks are appreciated. 

YOUR MAYBE FRIENDLY NIGHBBOURHOOD DEVELOPER/YOUTUBER SOMETHING
ARANGE

notes.title: Inescaped Multiplayer Update #2
notes.content:
Hewo, I am Arange with an update on Inescaped. I was working on a singleplayer story update for inescaped but since its taking some time, I have released this small update for Multiplayer which fixes a few bugs, increases spawn of items, switches the perspective to First Person and more.

The Third Person perspective was test and I now know its not good for a game like Inescaped, I mean it could have been utilized better but right now the level design doesnt support Third person so we revert back to first person. The first person is still a bit buggy and I will fix it in the next update probably next week maybe.

I have adeed 3-4 jumpscares as a test to see if they fit well, will add more with coming updates.
AI has been overhauled, when the AI attacks, a small jumpscare anim plays in front of the player camera. AI also is a bit optimized the before and wont easily get stuck in positions. AI can now search and find players if it has lost the player vision, if it cant find the player within a certain time then it reverts back to patrolling.

The item spawns has been increased, now there are some items that will 100% spawn in the game. Spwan chances of other items has also been increased. 


Added a Exit to Main Menu button in the UI.

notes.title: Inescaped Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am Arange, the developer of Inescaped. The multiplayer is now finally out but please note that there might be bugs and glitches in the game right now. I wasnt able to fully test the game. It is meant to be played by 4 people but can also be played solo. If you face any bugs or have any feedback, feel free to contact me on discord and I will surely respond to your query. Thank you for giving me your time. 

Inescaped drops you into a deadly experiment where you and three other test subjects are locked inside a sprawling maze teeming with danger. The goal? Find a way out, if you can.

Starting with nothing but your wits, you’ll navigate the maze to collect valuable items while dodging the lurking monsters that haunt every corner. Bring back your loot to the Hall and trade it with the mysterious Vendor, saving up for the elusive Medallion. Only the Medallion can unlock the exit, but it comes at a steep cost: 30,000 Coins. Every risk you take could bring you closer to freedom—or set you back to zero.

Reviving in the Hall after death means dropping all your hard-earned items, and your coins vanish forever. Work together with other players, or go it alone. Will you escape... or will the maze become your final resting place?

notes.title: Small Patch 08.08.2024
notes.content: A small patch fixing bugs and adding more instructions so that players are not lost finding what to do. If you face any bugs or issues please do let me know so I can fix them. Please also take sometime to review the game and let me know if you have any suggestions. The multiplayer update will drop soon. Thank you for buying Inescaped.
